claims.statement: Acuerdo 007 de 2024 adopts the ordinary POT revision.
The current DTS says the CARDER microzonation technical supports remain in force.
Areas without microzonation information must apply NSR-10.
The municipality must adjust and harmonize the model to NSR-10 within 24 months.
The published design-spectrum figure is labelled β=5%.
The user-supplied importance factor follows NSR-10 Table A.2.5-1.
The inverse branch uses NSR-10 equation A.2.6-1.
Av is derived by algebraically inverting NSR-10 equation A.2.6-2.
The plateau branch uses NSR-10 equation A.2.6-3.
The installed municipal evidence does not attest the T < To entrance branch.
